sanskrit_verse: तपःक्रीताः प्रजा राज्ञा प्रभुर आसां ततो नृपः। ततस तद्वचसि स्थेयं वार्ता चासां तदाश्रया॥
transliteration: tapaḥkrītāḥ prajā rājñā prabhur āsāṃ tato nṛpaḥ | tatas tadvacasi stheyaṃ vārtā cāsāṃ tadāśrayā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those subjects who are earned through the austerity of the King become his responsibility; accordingly, the King becomes their guardian. Therefore, in accordance with their welfare, his speech and conduct must be established.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from sacrificial causation, not mere inheritance or title.
Responsibility is proportional to the capacity to sustain and elevate consciousness.
Leadership is a function of energetic alignment through tapas, not political assertion.
Restoration occurs through alignment with dharma-rooted communication and action.
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler has acquired subjects via tapas THEN ruler assumes full guardianship responsibility.
IF subject welfare is at stake THEN ruler's speech and actions MUST align with dharma-vacana.
IF misalignment detected THEN initiate consciousness-realignment protocol for ruler.
IF leadership legitimacy questioned THEN verify tapasic causation as foundational proof.
IF restoration required THEN activate varta-upasrita-prakriya (conduct-based reintegration).
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving sovereign duty, the Supreme Court must verify that rulership originates from tapas-generated entitlement. Legal standing derives solely from consciousness-grounded causation. The court shall enforce alignment between royal conduct and subject welfare without punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here functions through anupūrvaśaḥ—tapas manifests authority, which necessitates protection, hence speech and behavior must reflect that causal chain. Responsibility flows from capability, not coercion. Misalignment triggers restorative recalibration rather than punitive consequence.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: Authority born of tapas demands dharmic stewardship; thus, all leadership must serve consciousness elevation. There is no punishment—only realignment. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
